beaches.name: Agios Nikolaos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual at the right-hand end of the beach, away from the tavernas. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2005 to 2022; nudists are a minority in high season but mix without friction. The directory notes local signs elsewhere ban nudism while this beach's signs ban only camping; no formal designation is documented.

beaches.name: Fira
beaches.summary: Nude bathing predominates at this small pebble cove east of Agali. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2013 to 2021, from about 50% to 100% nude; the directory notes the Rough Guide has listed Fira as a nudist beach. Access is a 10-minute cliff path from Agali.

beaches.name: Katergo
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported among a mixed crowd at this boat-served beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2010 to 2021; nudity is easy before the excursion boats arrive around 11am and a minority afterwards, with some visits finding the beach fully clothed. A 2023 Greek press listicle names Katergo for nudism.
